$comment: Curated Destiny 2 subclass verb reference. Community-maintained; each entry cites its source. type: buff | debuff | effect.

entries.description: Increased movement speed and weapon handling; sprinting long enough grants a further speed boost and PvE damage resistance.
entries.pve: Damage resistance while at top speed.

entries.description: Target is charged with Arc energy and chains lightning to nearby enemies when damaged.
Target is disoriented and cannot fire; PvE combatants stop attacking.
entries.pve: Blinded combatants stop attacking; stuns Unstoppable Champions (with artifact support).
entries.pvp: Blinds the HUD and muffles audio.

entries.description: A trail of Arc energy that travels to the creating player and grants ability energy.
Stacking charge that, at max stacks, discharges a powerful bolt of lightning at a target.
Target burns with stacking Solar damage over time; at high stacks the target Ignites.
A large Solar explosion that damages the target and everything nearby.
entries.pvp: Lethal burst in a small radius.

entries.description: Increased weapon damage; weapons pierce Barrier Champion shields.
Health and shields regenerate over time, even while taking damage.
entries.pve: Strong sustain; stacks x2 for faster regen.

entries.description: An instant burst of healing.
A Solar pickup that grants grenade energy when collected.
Target is saturated with Void energy and explodes when damaged.
entries.pve: Volatile rounds pierce Barrier Champion shields.

entries.description: Target takes increased damage from all sources and has slowed movement.
Target cannot use abilities; active effects are removed.
entries.pve: Stuns Overload Champions; disables combatant abilities.

entries.description: Kills fully restore health and grant grenade energy; timer refreshes on each kill.
Player becomes invisible to enemies and disappears from radar.
entries.pvp: Removes from radar; shimmer still visible.

entries.description: A protective Void shield over your health bar that absorbs damage.
entries.pve: Also grants damage resistance vs combatants.

entries.description: A Void pickup that grants class ability energy when collected.
Target's movement, ability regen, and weapon handling are reduced; stacks to Freeze.
Target is encased in Stasis ice and cannot act; frozen targets can be Shattered.
Frozen or crystal-encased targets explode, damaging everything nearby.
A solid Stasis crystal that blocks movement and can be shattered for area damage.
Stacking damage resistance granted by collecting Stasis shards and other Stasis effects.
Target is lifted into the air by Strand fibers and cannot move or attack.
Target's outgoing damage is reduced.
Damaging the target spawns unraveling projectiles that seek other enemies.
entries.pve: Unraveling rounds pierce Barrier Champion shields.

entries.description: A ball of Strand matter that can be shot or thrown to deal area damage.
A Strand minion that seeks out and attacks enemies.
Strand body armor that greatly reduces incoming body damage.
Fill both Light and Dark meters to Transcend: bonus damage, ability regen, and a unique grenade.
Prismatic tracks Light and Darkness energy separately; dealing matching damage type fills each meter.
entries.pve: Balance Light and Dark damage to Transcend faster.
